scene: A single detached two-storey house with a pitched roof, a chimney, one front door at ground level and two windows upstairs, standing alone on the ground line. Nothing is stacked on top of it and no neighbour touches it. The huis-een and huis-meer cards reuse this drawing.
must: one house with its own pitched roof and its own front door at ground level.
avoid: a tall block with many identical floors (flat); a row of joined houses sharing walls (not the card); a shed or hut with no windows (not a home); a castle with towers (not the card).
contrast: Pair with flat. The only difference is the building: one low house with its own door and roof here, a tall block of many identical floors there.
example_nl: Wij wonen in een huis met een tuin.
example_en: We live in a house with a garden.
alt: Een laag gebouw met een schuin dak, een schoorsteen en een deur aan de voorkant.

scene: A tall rectangular block with six identical floors of windows, a small balcony under each upper window, a flat roof and one shared entrance door at ground level, standing alone on the ground line. No people, no sign, no neighbouring building.
must: one tall block of stacked identical floors with balconies and a flat roof.
avoid: a single low house with a pitched roof (huis); a row of terraced houses (huis); an office tower with no balconies (not the card); a hotel with a sign (needs text).
contrast: Pair with huis. The only difference is the building: a tall block of many identical floors with balconies here, one low house with its own roof there.
example_nl: Zij woont in een flat in de stad.
example_en: She lives in a flat in the city.
alt: Een hoog gebouw met zes verdiepingen, kleine balkons en een plat dak.

scene: One adult man in plain shirt and trousers, whole-figure, front view, arms down, on the ground line against a plain wall. Short cropped hair and a short beard; body, face shape and clothes are exactly as on the vrouw card. No jewellery.
must: short cropped hair and a short beard on an adult.
avoid: a figure with long hair and no beard (vrouw); a boy with no beard (not the card); a bald head with no beard (not the card); an adult in a dress (not the card).
contrast: Pair with vrouw. The only difference is the hair: short hair and a beard here, long hair and no beard there.
example_en: The man is reading a book.
alt: Een volwassene met kort haar en een baard staat rechtop tegen een lege muur.

scene: One adult woman in plain shirt and trousers, whole-figure, front view, arms down, on the ground line against a plain wall. Long hair falling past the shoulders and a smooth chin with no beard; body, face shape and clothes are exactly as on the man card. No jewellery.
must: long hair past the shoulders and no beard.
avoid: a figure with short hair and a beard (man); a girl with a small body (not the card); a long-haired figure with a beard (not the card); a short-haired figure with no beard (not the card).
contrast: Pair with man. The only difference is the hair: long hair and no beard here, short hair and a beard there.
example_nl: De vrouw werkt in een winkel.
example_en: The woman works in a shop.
alt: Een volwassene met lang haar en zonder baard staat rechtop tegen een lege muur.

scene: A small passenger car seen side-on, two of four wheels visible, two side doors, a sloping windscreen, a roof and a short boot, wheels on a flat road line, no driver. Two small side windows show empty seats; the body is short and boxy.
must: a short closed car body with doors and two side windows on four wheels.
avoid: a long vehicle with a row of six windows (bus); a bicycle with two thin spoked wheels (fiets); a lorry with a box on the back (not the card); a train (not the card).
contrast: Pair with bus and fiets. The only difference is the vehicle: a short body with two windows here, a long body with a row of windows or two thin wheels there.
example_nl: Mijn vader heeft een nieuwe auto.
example_en: My father has a new car.
alt: Een korte gesloten wagen met twee deuren staat op een rechte weg.

scene: A long bus seen side-on, flat roof, a row of six large passenger windows, a front door with one step, two wheels visible, on a flat road line, no driver. It is clearly more than twice as long as a car would be, with a plain front.
must: a long body with a row of six windows and a door with a step.
avoid: a short car with two side windows (auto); a bicycle (fiets); a tram on rails (not the card); a lorry with no windows (not the card).
contrast: Pair with auto and fiets. The only difference is the vehicle: a very long body with a row of windows here, a short body or two thin wheels there.
example_nl: De bus komt om acht uur.
example_en: The bus comes at eight o'clock.
alt: Een heel lang voertuig met een rij grote ramen en een deur met een trede.

scene: A plain bicycle seen side-on, two large thin spoked wheels, a slim frame, a saddle, handlebars and two pedals, resting on a small kickstand on the road line, no rider. The wheels are large compared with the frame.
must: two thin spoked wheels, handlebars and a saddle with no body around them.
avoid: a car with doors and a roof (auto); a long bus with a row of windows (bus); a motorbike with a thick engine block (not the card); a unicycle with one wheel (not the card).
contrast: Pair with auto and bus. The only difference is the vehicle: two thin wheels and an open frame here, a closed body with windows there.
example_nl: Ik ga met de fiets naar school.
example_en: I go to school by bicycle.
alt: Twee dunne wielen met een smal frame, een zadel en een stuur staan op een standaard.

scene: A wide view of a city from a gentle rise: about ten tall blocks of many floors standing close together, one high tower among them and one road leading in from the front with three small cars on it. Rows of identical windows on each block.
must: tall blocks packed close together with a tower and one road.
avoid: a few low houses round a small square (dorp); a single house in a field (not the card); a tall block on its own (flat); a crowd of people with no buildings (not the card).
contrast: Pair with dorp. The only difference is the size of the place: a dense group of tall blocks with a tower here, a few low houses round a square there.
alt: Een groep hoge gebouwen staat dicht op elkaar, met een toren en een weg met drie kleine wagens.

scene: A wide view of a small village from a gentle rise: about eight low houses with pitched roofs around a small square with one tree, a narrow lane, and open fields beyond with a few fence posts. Same viewpoint and sky as the city; everything is low.
must: a few low houses round a small square with one tree and open land beyond.
avoid: tall blocks and a tower filling the picture (stad); a single farmhouse alone (not the card); a row of seaside huts (not the card); a car park or a market (not the card).
contrast: Pair with stad. The only difference is the size of the place: a few low houses round a square here, a crowd of tall blocks there.
example_nl: Mijn oma woont in een klein dorp.
example_en: My grandmother lives in a small village.
alt: Een paar lage gebouwen staan rond een klein plein met een boom, en daarachter ligt open land.

scene: The same drawing as the huis card: one detached two-storey house with a pitched roof, a chimney, one front door and two windows, in the middle of the picture on a flat ground line under plain sky, with empty ground on both sides.
must: one single house with empty ground on both sides.
avoid: three houses in a row (huizen); a terrace of joined houses (not the card); a tall block (flat); a shed (not the card).
contrast: Pair with huis-meer. The only difference is the number: one house here, three identical houses side by side there.
example_nl: Het huis heeft een hoge deur.
example_en: The house has a tall door.
alt: Een enkel gebouw met een schuin dak en een schoorsteen staat in het midden op een vlakke grond.

scene: Three copies of the huis drawing: identical detached two-storey houses with pitched roofs, chimneys, one front door and two windows each, evenly spaced with gaps of empty ground between them on one flat ground line under plain sky, each the same size as the single house.
must: three identical houses separated by gaps.
avoid: one house alone (huis); a terrace of joined houses (not the card); three tall blocks (flat); two houses (not the card).
contrast: Pair with huis-een. The only difference is the number: three identical houses with gaps here, one house alone there.
example_nl: De huizen staan aan het plein.
example_en: The houses stand on the square.
alt: Drie gelijke gebouwen met schuine daken en schoorstenen staan naast elkaar met ruimte ertussen.
